#! -rules CONF-02 -strict
# TTL and MaxAge on lease buckets, per-key TTLs (an unresolved key and a lease key), CAS on the leader
# key (jetstream and the legacy API; kv.go:19 is both a lease TTL and CAS on a lease key), and the
# nats.c forms: a TTL on a lease bucket and on one the lint cannot resolve, CAS on a #define'd leader key
# and on an unresolved key (fails closed: desc.cpp's member assignment and re-pointable `key` must not
# resolve the parameters of config.cpp:6 and leader.cpp:11, nor may elect_opts.cpp's default argument
# `key = "zone.1"`). In Go NATS code, CAS on a key the lint cannot resolve and a TTL on a bucket it cannot
# resolve fail closed (kv.go:18 is both an unresolved KeyTTL key and CAS on it; elect.go, both APIs).
# A TTL in a nats.c file that sets no Bucket fails closed (ttl_helper.cpp), also in a file that includes
# <nats.h> and never names kvConfig (ttl_include.cpp). A nats.c MaxAge (a jsStreamConfig field) counts on
# a lease bucket's KV_ stream, and kvStore_*WithTTL is CAS with a per-key TTL (stream.cpp). A MaxAge on a
# stream whose name does not resolve fails closed in a file that uses KV (kv_stream.cpp; js_DeleteKeyValue
# counts, kv_delete.cpp) or names a "KV_" stream (kv_prefix.cpp), and so does one in a KV file that sets no
# stream Name (kv_noname.cpp).
# TTL fields assigned after the literal count the same way (ttl_assign.go: a lease bucket, a parameter's
# unresolved bucket, a field of the config type, a lease bucket's KV_ stream), also on configs reached
# through new(T), an address, an index, a range variable or an element's copy, and in a collection literal's
# elided elements, and on an element of a make() collection or of a variadic parameter (ttl_forms.go; cfgs
# and vcfgs are parameters, so their buckets do not resolve). Names are not scoped, so a range variable or
# parameter named like a DIRECTORY config must not borrow its bucket (ttl_shared.go: a range over a
# collection holding LEASES, over a parameter's, and a parameter; a parameter collection named like a
# DIRECTORY one, :43, a range variable over it, :45, and a copy of one of its elements, :48). A range
# variable or element copy is its own config: a later same-named one over a DIRECTORY collection gives
# neither it nor its collection that bucket (ttl_order.go: a parameter's collection and a make() one).
# (CONF-01 also fires on these buckets; this fixture runs CONF-02 alone.)
